purpose: Meter neural module costs and select the smallest physically paid neural profile that preserves 0.6.1 safety and actuator-fault conservation.

development_findings: recurrence did not show net value in the short development sweep
prediction showed a small possible value signal
smaller tissues improved cost-inclusive margin in development
efficient4 and efficient2 were added before this final preregistration

actuator_fault.primary: conservation lease versus no-conservation common-disturbance twin margin AUC

selection_rule.prediction: retain unless no_prediction exceeds full8 margin AUC in at least 3/4 screening seeds and the confirmation profiles do not require prediction
selection_rule.recurrence: retain only if full8 exceeds no_recurrence in at least 3/4 screening seeds and mean margin gain exceeds recurrence ATP/material cost signal
selection_rule.diagnosis: active semantic diagnosis remains dormant unless it shows positive net value; mechanism-conservation diagnostics remain required
selection_rule.selected_size: choose the smallest candidate whose confirmation mean AUC is no more than 0.02 below full8, remains above no_tissue, has no stable false lease, and preserves actuator-fault conservation in at least 4/6 paired seeds
selection_rule.tie_breaker: lower module ATP and material wear, then fewer compartments
selection_rule.module_retirement: non-positive modules are disabled or placed in dormant profiles; negative findings are preserved

inherited_gates: UI1 compact HUD and safe reset retained

amendment.reason: Formal062Config.from_state incorrectly passed derived audit_active_cells into the parent constructor, preventing clone/save restoration used by the actuator-fault twin.
amendment.screening_confirmation_stable_impact: none; those completed paths did not call Formal062World.clone/from_state
amendment.actuator_fault_status: all earlier attempts failed before comparison and are excluded; no successful fault holdout result was observed before this amendment
